name: data.police.uk API
tagline: UK street-level crime, outcomes, and neighbourhood policing data
description: Public REST API from UK police forces providing street-level crime and outcome data, neighbourhood boundaries, and local policing team information. Free with no authentication required for standard use. Covers England, Wales, and Northern Ireland crime data.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints. API is free and open.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unlimited free access; no key required

use_cases: get street-level crimes near a lat/lng
list crime categories for a date
get neighbourhood boundaries for a force
find outcomes for a specific crime
locate nearest police neighbourhood for coordinates
